# Copyright (c) 2026 agentctl contributors.
"""Owned, audited toolchain attempts with no reachable installer executable."""

import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path

from agentctl.bootstrap import toolchain
from agentctl.bootstrap.pins import Version, load
from agentctl.bootstrap.plan import GhcupCommand
from agentctl.check.audit import install
from agentctl.hostfacts import HostContext, HostFacts, Prerequisite, current, expected_probes, ghcup_destination
from agentctl.process import run
from agentctl.result import Err, Ok, Result

mode, directory, log, nonce, ghc, cabal = sys.argv[1:]
directory = Path(directory)
home = directory / "home"
home.mkdir()
environment = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if key not in {"GHCUP_USE_XDG_DIRS", "XDG_BIN_HOME"}}
environment.update({"HOME": str(home), "USERPROFILE": str(home), "PATH": "", "GHCUP_INSTALL_BASE_PREFIX": str(home)})
context = replace(current(directory / "cache"), home=home, cwd=directory, environment=tuple(environment.items()), interactive=False)
pins = load()
assert isinstance(pins, Ok)
assert isinstance(install(Path(log), nonce), Ok)
control = run([sys.executable, "-c", "print('observer control')"], cwd=directory, env=environment)
assert isinstance(control, Ok) and control.value.code == 0
if mode in {"ghc", "cabal"}:
    assert context.family in {"Linux", "Darwin", "Windows"}
    candidate = ghcup_destination(context.family, environment, home)
    candidate.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    harmless = Path(os.environ["SYSTEMROOT"]) / "System32/where.exe" if context.family == "Windows" else Path(shutil.which("false"))
    shutil.copy2(harmless, candidate)
    def version_probe(path: str, _context: HostContext) -> Version | None:
        return pins.value.ghcup_floor if path == str(candidate.resolve()) else pins.value.ghc if path == ghc else None
    def prerequisites(_context: HostContext):
        return Ok(tuple(Prerequisite(name, True) for name in expected_probes(context.family)))
    if mode == "cabal":
        assert toolchain.record(toolchain.Toolchain(ghc, str(directory / "missing-cabal")), context.cache) == Ok(toolchain.Toolchain(ghc, str(directory / "missing-cabal")))
    result = toolchain.ensure(context, pins.value, prerequisites, inspect_versions=version_probe)
    assert isinstance(result, Err)
    payload = {"refused": True}
else:
    tools = toolchain.Toolchain(ghc, cabal)
    if mode == "whereis":
        facts = HostFacts("Linux", "x86_64", directory / "unexecuted-ghcup", None, None, None)
        actions = (GhcupCommand(facts.ghcup_destination, ("whereis", "ghc", "9.12.4")), GhcupCommand(facts.ghcup_destination, ("whereis", "cabal", "3.16.1.0")))
        def answer(action: GhcupCommand, context: HostContext) -> Result[str, toolchain.ToolchainError]:
            return Ok(ghc if action.arguments[1] == "ghc" else cabal)
        result = toolchain.apply(facts, pins.value, context, actions, toolchain.Actuation(invoke=answer))
    else:
        assert mode == "warm"
        assert toolchain.record(tools, context.cache) == Ok(tools)
        result = toolchain.ensure(context, pins.value)
    assert result == Ok(tools), result
    payload = {"ghc": result.value.ghc, "cabal": result.value.cabal}
    payload["record"] = (context.cache / "toolchain-paths.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(payload))
